shorts_extract.hook: Five hours of silence, one jammed glass slide, and a machine-gun burst of spikes: how Hubel & Wiesel cracked V1's edge code and inspired modern AI.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Hubel & Wiesel (1959/1968 J. Physiol.): V1 orientation tuning, Simple to Complex hierarchy, orientation/ocular columns + 1963 critical periods.
shorts_extract.twist: Why uniform floodlight cancels to zero, how infant cataract surgery saved millions of kids' sight, and how Simple/Complex cells became AI CNNs.
